verses.geez: ወእንዘ፡ የሐውሩ፡ ፍኖቶሙ፡ በጽሑ፡ በጣኔስ፡ ውስተ፡ ተከዚ፡ ምሴተ፡ ወቤቱ፡ በህየ።
verses.translation: And as they went on their journey, they came in the evening to the river Tigris, and they lodged there.

translations.lxx: And as they went on their journey, they came in the evening to the river Tigris, and they lodged there.
translations.ron: Iar călătorii au ajuns seara la fluviul Tigru şi s-au oprit peste noapte acolo.

verses.geez: ወወረደ፡ ውእቱ፡ ወልድ፡ ይትሐፀብ፡ ወሠረረ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ ዓሣ፡ እምውስተ፡ ተከዚ፡ ወፈቀደ፡ የሐጦ፡ ለውእቱ፡ ወልድ።
verses.translation: And when the young man went down to wash himself, a fish leaped out of the river, and would have devoured him.

translations.lxx: And when the young man went down to wash himself, a fish leaped out of the river, and would have devoured him.
translations.ron: Şi tânărul s-a dus să se spele, dar din fluviu a sărit un peşte şi a vrut să înghită pe tânăr.

verses.geez: ወይቤሎ፡ መልአክ፡ አኃዞ፡ ለውእቱ፡ ዓሣ፡ ወአኃዞ፡ ለዓሣ፡ ውእቱ፡ ወልድ፡ ወአውጽኦ፡ ውስተ፡ ምድር።
verses.translation: Then the angel said unto him, Take the fish. And the young man laid hold of the fish, and drew it to land.

translations.lxx: Then the angel said unto him, Take the fish. And the young man laid hold of the fish, and drew it to land.
translations.ron: Atunci îngerul a zis către el: :Prinde acest peşte!" Şi tânărul a apucat peştele şi l-a târât pe uscat.

verses.geez: ወይቤሎ፡ ዝኩ፡ መልአክ፡ ምትሮ፡ ለውእቱ፡ ዓሣ፡ ወንሣእ፡ ልቦ፡ ወከብዶ፡ ወሐሞቶ፡ ወአጽንዕ፡ ዓቂቦቶ።
verses.translation: To whom the angel said, Open the fish, and take the heart and the liver and the gall, and put them up safely.

translations.lxx: To whom the angel said, Open the fish, and take the heart and the liver and the gall, and put them up safely.
translations.ron: Şi i-a zis îngerul: "Spintecă peştele şi i-ai inima, ficatul şi fierea, şi păstrează-le!"

verses.geez: ወገብረ፡ ውእቱ፡ ወልድ፡ በከመ፡ አዘዞ፡ መልአክ፡ ወዓሣሁኒ፡ ጠበሱ፡ ወበልዑ፡ ወጌሡ፡ ክልኤሆሙ፡ ወበጽሑ፡ በጣኔስ።
verses.translation: So the young man did as the angel commanded him; and when they had roasted the fish, they did eat it: then they both went on their way, till they drew near to Ecbatane.

translations.lxx: So the young man did as the angel commanded him; and when they had roasted the fish, they did eat it: then they both went on their way, till they drew near to Ecbatane.
translations.ron: Şi a făcut tânărul cum i-a zis îngerul, iar peştele l-au fript şi l-au mâncat.

verses.geez: ወይቤሎ፡ ዝኩ፡ ወልድ፡ ለመልአክ፡ አንተ፡ እኁየ፡ አዛርያ፡ ምንት፡ ውእቱ፡ ከብዱ፡ ወልቡ፡ ወሐሞቱ፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ዓሣ።
verses.translation: Then the young man said to the angel, Brother Azarias, to what use is the heart and the liver and the gall of the fish?

translations.lxx: Then the young man said to the angel, Brother Azarias, to what use is the heart and the liver and the gall of the fish?
translations.ron: Şi au plecat amândoi mai departe şi au ajuns la Ecbatana.

verses.geez: ወይቤሎ፡ ልቡ፡ ወከብዱ፡ ለእመቦ፡ ዘየሐምሞ፡ ጋኔን፡ እኵይ፡ ዘንተ፡ ያጠይሱ፡ ቅድሜሁ፡ ለውእቱ፡ ብእሲ፡ ወእመኒ፡ ብእሲት፡ ወኢየሐምም፡ እንከ።
verses.translation: And he said unto him, Touching the heart and the liver, if a devil or an evil spirit trouble any, we must make a smoke thereof before the man or the woman, and the party shall be no more vexed.

translations.lxx: And he said unto him, Touching the heart and the liver, if a devil or an evil spirit trouble any, we must make a smoke thereof before the man or the woman, and the party shall be no more vexed.
translations.ron: Şi a zis tânărul către înger: "Frate Azaria, pentru ce sunt bune ficatul, inima şi fierea acestui peşte?"

verses.geez: ወሐሞቶሰ፡ ይኵሕልዎ፡ ለብእሲ፡ ዘቦቱ፡ ጢስ፡ ውስተ፡ አዕይንቲሁ፡ ወየሐዩ።
verses.translation: As for the gall, it is good to anoint a man that hath whiteness in his eyes, and he shall be healed.

translations.lxx: As for the gall, it is good to anoint a man that hath whiteness in his eyes, and he shall be healed.
translations.ron: Şi acela i-a răspuns: "De-l chinuie pe cineva un demon sau un duh rău, se afumă bărbatul sau femeia aceea cu inima şi ficatul şi nu-l va mai munci.

verses.geez: ወሶበ፡ ቀርቡ፡ ኀበ፡ ራጊስ፡ ወይቤሎ፡ ውእቱ፡ መልአክ፡ አንተ፡ እኁየ፡ ዮምኬ፡ ኀበ፡ ራጉኤል፡ ነኅድር።
verses.translation: And when they were come near to Rages,

translations.lxx: And when they were come near to Rages,
translations.ron: Iar cu fierea se unge la ochi omul care are albeaţă, şi se vindecă".

verses.geez: ወአዝማዲከ፡ ውእቱ፡ ወቦ፡ አሐቲ፡ ወለት፡ ዘስማ፡ ሣራ፡ ወእትናገርኑ፡ በእንቲአሃ፡ የሀቡከ፡ ትኩንከ፡ ብእሲተ።
verses.translation: the angel said to the young man, Brother, to day we shall lodge with Raguel, who is thy cousin; he also hath one only daughter, named Sara; I will speak for her, that she may be given thee for a wife.

translations.lxx: the angel said to the young man, Brother, to day we shall lodge with Raguel, who is thy cousin; he also hath one only daughter, named Sara; I will speak for her, that she may be given thee for a wife.
translations.ron: Iar dacă s-au apropiat de Ecbatana,

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ለከ፡ ይበጽሐከ፡ ርስታ፡ ወአንተ፡ ሀሎከ፡ እምነ፡ አዝማዲሃ፡ ወወለታኒ፡ ሠናይት፡ ወጠባብ።
verses.translation: For to thee doth the right of her appertain, seeing thou only art of her kindred.

translations.lxx: For to thee doth the right of her appertain, seeing thou only art of her kindred.
translations.ron: A zis îngerul către tânăr: "Frate, acum avem să poposim la Raguel, ruda ta, care are o fată cu numele Sara.

verses.geez: ወይእዜኒ፡ ስምዓኒ፡ ወእትናገሮ፡ ለአቡሃ፡ ወሶበ፡ ገባዕነ፡ እምነ፡ ራጊስ፡ ንገብር፡ በዓለ፡ እስመ፡ ኢይገብር፡ የሀባ፡ ራጉኤል፡ ለካልዕ፡ ሰብእ፡ በእንተ፡ ሕገ፡ ሙሴ፡ ወእምአብደረ፡ ትሙት፡ እስመ፡ ርስታ፡ ለከ፡ ይበጽሐከ፡ እምኵሉ፡ ሰብእ።
verses.translation: And the maid is fair and wise: now therefore hear me, and I will speak to her father; and when we return from Rages we will celebrate the marriage: for I know that Raguel cannot marry her to another according to the law of Moses, but he shall be guilty of death, because the right of inheritance doth rather appertain to thee than to any other.

translations.lxx: And the maid is fair and wise: now therefore hear me, and I will speak to her father; and when we return from Rages we will celebrate the marriage: for I know that Raguel cannot marry her to another according to the law of Moses, but he shall be guilty of death, because the right of inheritance doth rather appertain to thee than to any other.
translations.ron: Am să vorbesc de ea ca să ţi-o dea de femeie, că ţie ţi-e dat s-o moşteneşti, fiindcă eşti din neamul ei, iar fata este frumoasă şi deşteaptă.

verses.geez: ወይቤሎ፡ ዝኩ፡ ወልድ፡ ለውእቱ፡ መልአክ፡ አንተ፡ እኁየ፡ አዛርያ፡ ሰማዕኩ፡ አነ፡ ከመ፡ አስተዋሰብዋ፡ ለይእቲ፡ ወለት፡ ለሰብእቱ፡ ዕደው፡ ወኵሎሙ፡ ሞቱ፡ አመ፡ ከብካብ።
verses.translation: Then the young man answered the angel, I have heard, brother Azarias, that this maid hath been given to seven men, who all died in the marriage chamber.

translations.lxx: Then the young man answered the angel, I have heard, brother Azarias, that this maid hath been given to seven men, who all died in the marriage chamber.
translations.ron: Deci, să mă asculţi pe mine, că eu am să grăiesc cu tatăl ei, şi când ne vom întoarce din Ragheş vom face nunta. Eu cunosc pe Raguel. El n-are să vrea s-o dea după bărbat străin, împotriva legii lui Moise, fiindcă s-ar face vinovat de moarte, căci moştenirea se cuvine s-o primeşti tu, iar nu altul".

verses.geez: ወይእዜኒ፡ ባሕቲትየ፡ አነ፡ ለአቡየ፡ እፈርህ፡ ሶበ፡ ቦእኩ፡ ኢይሙት፡ ወኢይወርድ፡ ሕይወቶሙ፡ ለአቡየ፡ ወእምየ፡ በፃዕር፡ ወአልቦሙ፡ ካልዕ፡ ወልድ፡ ዘይቀብሮሙ።
verses.translation: And now I am the only son of my father, and I am afraid, lest, if I go in unto her, I die, as the others before: for a wicked spirit loveth her, which hurteth no one except those which come unto her: wherefore I also fear lest I die, and bring my father's and my mother's life because of me to the grave with sorrow: for they have no other son to bury them.

translations.lxx: And now I am the only son of my father, and I am afraid, lest, if I go in unto her, I die, as the others before: for a wicked spirit loveth her, which hurteth no one except those which come unto her: wherefore I also fear lest I die, and bring my father's and my mother's life because of me to the grave with sorrow: for they have no other son to bury them.
translations.ron: Atunci tânărul a zis către înger: "Frate Azaria, eu am auzit că această fată a fost măritată cu şapte bărbaţi şi că toţi au pierit în camera de nuntă. Eu însă sunt singur la tata şi mă tem ca nu cumva intrând la ea să mor ca şi ceilalţi. Pe ea o iubeşte un demon care nu face rău nimănui, decât numai celor ce se apropie de ea.

verses.geez: ወይቤሎ፡ ውእቱ፡ መልአክ፡ ኢትዜከርኑ፡ ቃለ፡ ዘአዘዘከ፡ አቡከ፡ ከመ፡ ትንሣእ፡ ለከ፡ ብእሲተ፡ አምአዝማዲከ፡ ወይእዜኒ፡ ስምዐኒ፡ አንተ፡ እኁየ፡ ወበእንተ፡ ጋኔንሰ፡ ኢያኅዝንከ፡ እስመ፡ በዝንቱ፡ ሌሊት፡ ትትወሀብ፡ ለከ፡ ብእሲት፡ እምአዝማዲከ።
verses.translation: Then the angel said to him, Dost thou not remember the precepts that thy father gave thee, that thou shouldest marry a wife of thine own kindred? wherefore hear me, O my brother; for she shall be given thee to wife; and make thou no reckoning of the evil spirit; for this same night shall she be given thee in marriage.

translations.lxx: Then the angel said to him, Dost thou not remember the precepts that thy father gave thee, that thou shouldest marry a wife of thine own kindred? wherefore hear me, O my brother; for she shall be given thee to wife; and make thou no reckoning of the evil spirit; for this same night shall she be given thee in marriage.
translations.ron: Şi de aceea mă tem ca nu cumva să mor şi să cobor viaţa tatălui şi a mamei mele în mormânt prin întristarea după mine, căci ei n-au alt fiu care să-i îngroape".

verses.geez: ወሶበ፡ ቦእከ፡ ውስተ፡ ጽርሕከ፡ ንሣእ፡ ለከ፡ ሕራረ፡ ዕጣን፡ ወደይ፡ እምነ፡ ከብዱ፡ ወልቡ፡ ለዝኩ፡ ዓሣ፡ ወአጢስ፡ ቦቱ።
verses.translation: And when thou shalt come into the marriage chamber, thou shalt take the ashes of perfume, and shalt lay upon them some of the heart and liver of the fish, and shalt make a smoke with it:

translations.lxx: And when thou shalt come into the marriage chamber, thou shalt take the ashes of perfume, and shalt lay upon them some of the heart and liver of the fish, and shalt make a smoke with it:
translations.ron: Şi i-a zis îngerul: "Oare ai uitat cuvintele pe care ţi le-a spus tatăl tău, ca să-ti iei femeie din neamul tău? Ascultă-mă deci pe mine, frate. Ea trebuie să fie femeia ta, iar de demon nu te nelinişti! Chiar în noaptea aceasta au să ţi-o dea de femeie.

verses.geez: ወሶበ፡ ፄነዎ፡ ለውእቱ፡ ጋኔን፡ ይጐይይ፡ ወኢይገብእ፡ ለዓለም፡ ወሶበ፡ ቦእከ፡ ኀቤሃ፡ ጽርሑ፡ ክልኤክሙ፡ ኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ መሐሪ፡ ወያድኅነክሙ፡ ወይምሕረክሙ፡ ወኢትፍርሁ፡ እንከ፡ እስመ፡ ኪያክሙ፡ አስተዳለወ፡ እምነ፡ ዓለም፡ ወአንተ፡ ታድኅና፡ ወተሐውር፡ ምስሌከ፡ ወእብለከ፡ ከመ፡ ትረክብ፡ ውሉደ፡ እምኔሃ፡ ወሰሚዖ፡ ጦብያ፡ አንከረ፡ ወተለዋ፡ ነፍሱ፡ ኀቤሃ፡ ጥቀ፡ ወበጽሑ፡ ውስተ፡ በጣኔስ።
verses.translation: and the devil shall smell it, and flee away, and never come again any more: but when thou shalt come to her, rise up both of you, and pray to God which is merciful, who will have pity on you, and save you: fear not, for she is appointed unto thee from the beginning; and thou shalt preserve her, and she shall go with thee. Moreover I suppose that she shall bear thee children. Now when Tobias had heard these things, he loved her, and his heart was effectually joined to her. And he came to Ecbatane.

translations.lxx: and the devil shall smell it, and flee away, and never come again any more: but when thou shalt come to her, rise up both of you, and pray to God which is merciful, who will have pity on you, and save you: fear not, for she is appointed unto thee from the beginning; and thou shalt preserve her, and she shall go with thee. Moreover I suppose that she shall bear thee children. Now when Tobias had heard these things, he loved her, and his heart was effectually joined to her. And he came to Ecbatane.
translations.ron: Deci, când vei intra în camera de nuntă, să iei căţuia, să pui în ea inima şi ficatul peştelui şi să afumi; şi demonul va simţi mirosul şi se va depărta şi nu se va mai întoarce niciodată,
